states: Private mock stack built from this tree (backend :7681, Vite :5199) after restoring the original record selection and gating temperatureDetails on a current CPU reading

Proxmox node Analytics A (pve31) made PVE-only (agent facet removed from REST and websocket payloads), compared on identical data: main's adapter showed CPU low 63°C and CPU record 63°C (the current reading repeated); this change showed CPU low 39°C and CPU record 91°C from an injected temperatureDetails record (cpuMin 38.5, cpuMaxRecord 91.2) at 1440x900 and 390x844
Same PVE-only node without a record in temperatureDetails: CPU low and CPU record rows absent; NVMe row and table TEMP unchanged
Operator-context Temperature row: hidden on main and on this change at 63°C (it appears only in the warning band), so no difference
Agent-linked mock node with and without an injected record, desktop and phone width: no CPU low/record rows and Temperature from the agent facet, as on main
Unit tests cover the two cases this commit fixes: details with only NVMe do not displace a valid scalar CPU reading, and an unusable legacy record still falls back to the scalar
interactions: Opened the node drawer from the row's detail toggle (aria-controls proxmox-host-drawer-<id>) on /proxmox at desktop and phone widths
Read the Thermals and Operator context rows and the row's TEMP cell, and took screenshots, for main's adapter and for this change via Playwright with REST and websocket payload rewriting
